subject: LendingCorp due diligence: requested SDLC evidence and artifacts
messages:
From: Security Assessor <security_assessor@trustaudits.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SDLC evidence for LendingCorp SOC2 intake

Hi Vanessa,

As part of LendingCorp's SOC2 intake we need to collect a short package of Secure SDLC evidence tied to your customer-facing inference runtime that LendingCorp relies on. Can you please provide the following artifacts or a pointer to a secure shared location by EOD Nov 17?

1) Code review policy and a snapshot of PR approval logs for the last 12 months for the inference-runtime repo.
2) CI/CD pipeline configuration and the controls (branch protections, required checks).
3) Evidence of secrets management and rotation (how ephemeral CI tokens are issued and rotated).
4) Change management index or ledger summarizing production deploys and emergency patches (last 12 months).
5) Short attestation on who is authorized to approve emergency releases / rollback.

File format is flexible (PDF, CSV, XLSX). If anything must be redacted, please include a brief rationale. If you have a shared drive link or HubSpot intake record, include that as well.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Senior Assessor, TrustAudits
security_assessor@trustaudits.com

[Attachment: SOC2-SDLC-Checklist.pdf (requested template)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Security Assessor <security_assessor@trustaudits.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SDLC evidence for LendingCorp SOC2 intake

Hi Maya,

Thanks — we can assemble this. Quick clarifications so we package only what you need:
- The primary repo is 'inference-runtime' (public code with internal service configs). Do you need PRs for infra repos as well (ci-ops, key-management)?
- For secrets rotation: do you want rotation events (audit logs) or the rotation policy + a sampling of rotation events?

Planned delivery: a redacted bundle (PDF + CSVs + XLSX index) in a shared Drive folder by Nov 16 EOD. Owners: Jordan will export PR approvals, Irene will assemble CI pipeline snapshots and redaction notes, Lauren will provide the change-management ledger and emergency-approval attestation.

Short preview of attachments we'll include:
- ci-pipeline-snapshot-2027-11.pdf [Attachment]
- inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv [Attachment — will redact committer emails]
- kms-rotation-policy-2027.pdf [Attachment]
- change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx [Attachment]

If that plan works I'll route the shared folder link up once assembled.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

[Note: Some audit logs contain account identifiers for third-party cloud accounts — we'll redact those but provide a redaction map.]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: SDLC evidence for LendingCorp SOC2 intake — artifact owners and checklist

Team — forwarding the assessor ask (below). Please action with the owners noted. Target: assemble and drop into the shared Drive folder by COB Nov 15 so I can do a final pass and send Nov 16 morning.

Action items:
- Jordan: export PR approval history for inference-runtime (last 12 months). Include: PR ID, author (redact emails), reviewers, approval timestamps, merge status. Save as CSV 'inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv'.
- Irene: snapshot CI pipeline configuration and required checks (branch protection settings). Produce 'ci-pipeline-snapshot-2027-11.pdf' and a short explanation of ephemeral token issuance/rotation.
- Lauren: export change management index covering production deploys, emergency patches, rollbacks; provide names/titles of approvers and a short attestation doc. Save as 'change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx'.

Security notes: don't include raw secret values or long-lived credential dumps in any file. If you need to attach logs that have identifiers, include a redaction map and we will label what was removed. Use the shared folder under: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BcExampleDriveLink

If something will be delayed note it here and propose an alternate delivery.

Thanks,
V

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SDLC evidence for LendingCorp SOC2 intake — artifact owners and checklist

Vanessa — I ran the exports this morning. Items uploaded to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BcExampleDriveLink

Files placed:
- inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv [CSV: PR, short title, author-id (redacted), reviewers, approvals, merged_at]
- change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx [XLSX: deploy id, date, owner, purpose, approver, rollback_flag]
- ci-credential-sample.txt [TXT: example ephemeral token metadata (no secret), issuance_ts, expiry_ts]

Notes: branch protection enforced for main: required status checks = ['unit-tests', 'integration-smoke', 'security-scan']; required review count = 2; auto-merge disabled for high-risk labels. CI ephemeral tokens are minted by the internal runner service and expire by default after 12 hours. KMS key references redacted as requested.

If you want, I can create a short narrative 'evidence-readme.pdf' tying files to the questionnaire items.

— Jordan

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Security Assessor <security_assessor@trustaudits.com>, Samir Patel <samir@lendingcorp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Delivery: SDLC evidence bundle for LendingCorp intake (redacted)

Hi Maya / Samir,

Per the Nov 10 request, attached is a redacted SDLC evidence bundle for the inference-runtime that supports LendingCorp's integration. I've included a short narrative to map artifacts to the checklist. Key points below, then attachments and the shared folder link.

Executive summary (short):
- Code review: All production code requires 2 reviewers; branch protection blocks merges until required checks pass. See 'inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv' for a 12-month snapshot (author emails redacted).
- CI/CD controls: 'ci-pipeline-snapshot-2027-11.pdf' summarizes pipeline stages, required checks, and runner security posture. We run both unit and integration tests and a security scan prior to merge.
- Secrets management & rotation: We use cloud KMS for runtime secrets and HSM-backed keys for signing. Ephemeral CI tokens are minted by an internal service and expire by default at 12 hours; samples included in 'ci-credential-sample.txt'. Rotation policy is documented in 'kms-rotation-policy-2027.pdf'.
- Change management: 'change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx' lists production deploys, owners, approvers and emergency-release justifications. Emergency releases require explicit written attestation from (1) Engineering Manager and (2) Product Security Lead.

Attachments included (redacted where applicable):
- inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv [CSV — redacted emails]
- ci-pipeline-snapshot-2027-11.pdf [PDF]
- kms-rotation-policy-2027.pdf [PDF]
- change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx [XLSX]
- ci-credential-sample.txt [TXT — metadata only, no secrets]
- evidence-readme-2027-11.pdf [PDF — narrative mapping artifacts to questionnaire items]

Shared folder (view-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BcExampleDriveLink
HubSpot intake record: https://hubspot.com/records/LDG-12345

Redactions: We redacted cloud account ARNs and internal service principal IDs to protect third-party account identifiers. A redaction map is in the shared folder. If you require additional unredacted logs under an NDA or a scoped assessor account, we can coordinate with LendingCorp procurement to set that up.

Let me know if you need any clarifications or a short walkthrough.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

[Attachments: inference-runtime-pr-approvals-2027-11.csv; ci-pipeline-snapshot-2027-11.pdf; kms-rotation-policy-2027.pdf; change-management-index-2026-2027.xlsx; ci-credential-sample.txt; evidence-readme-2027-11.pdf]
